# Reason codes

Every refusal, rejection and fault in Neura carries one stable code from a single catalog, the same in the robot runtime, the gateway, the site agent, the management API and the console. Codes are never reused or renamed. A `fatal` code latches a fault on the robot: only an explicit local reset clears it.

Catalog version 1, 98 codes.

## Contracts

| Code | Severity | Retryable | HTTP | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CONTRACT_INVALID` | error | no |  | The document does not match its contract schema. |
| `CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION` | error | no |  | The document's api_version is not supported by this release. |
| `COMPAT_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | The execution profile is bound to a different model artifact. |
| `COMPAT_ROBOT_PROFILE_DIGEST_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | The execution profile is bound to a different robot profile. |
| `COMPAT_ACTION_FEATURE_MISSING` | error | no |  | The model outputs an action the robot's command interface does not accept. |
| `COMPAT_ACTION_FEATURE_UNUSED` | error | no |  | The robot's command interface requires an action the model does not output. |
| `COMPAT_ACTION_ORDER_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | Action order differs between model and robot and no reorder transform is declared. |
| `COMPAT_UNIT_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | Units differ between model and robot and no unit conversion is declared. |
| `COMPAT_FRAME_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | Reference frames differ between model and robot. |
| `COMPAT_SEMANTICS_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | Action semantics differ between model and robot (for example absolute vs delta). |
| `COMPAT_STATE_FEATURE_MISSING` | error | no |  | The model requires a state input the robot does not provide. |
| `COMPAT_STATE_FEATURE_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | A state input differs in unit, frame or shape between model and robot. |
| `COMPAT_CAMERA_MISSING` | error | no |  | The model requires a camera the robot does not provide. |
| `COMPAT_CAMERA_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | A camera differs in resolution or color order between model and robot. |
| `COMPAT_IMAGE_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED` | error | no |  | The selected image encoding is not accepted by the model or not produced by the robot. |
| `COMPAT_CONTROL_PERIOD_MISMATCH` | error | no |  | Control periods differ between model, robot and execution profile. |
| `COMPAT_CHUNK_SETTINGS_INVALID` | error | no |  | Chunk settings in the execution profile are inconsistent with the model. |
| `COMPAT_MERGE_MODE_NOT_VALIDATED` | error | no |  | The selected chunk merge mode is not validated for this model. |
| `COMPAT_FAULT_RESPONSE_NOT_VALIDATED` | error | no |  | The selected starvation response is not validated for this robot. |
| `COMPAT_PRECISION_UNSUPPORTED` | error | no |  | The selected device or precision is not supported by the model. |
| `COMPAT_STATEFUL_POLICY_UNSUPPORTED` | error | no |  | Stateful policies are not supported by this release. |
| `COMPAT_LANGUAGE_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED` | error | no |  | The model requires a language instruction the execution profile does not provide. |
| `COMPAT_TRANSFORM_INVALID` | error | no |  | A declared adapter transform does not apply to the model and robot. |
